name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Pleasant Prairie WI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck/main entrance off 88th Ave at ~42.5430,-87.9128; site fully ringed by chain-link fence (confirmed in multiple Street View frames along the 88th Ave frontage). Driveway pinches to a marked entry island where it crosses the fence line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear staffed guard booth visible at the entrance island in z21 satellite; a small control island/pad sits in the entry throat. Marked uncertain - likely automated/kiosk check-in rather than a manned shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true: gate present, no manned guard shack evident, so check-in is most likely kiosk/app based (consistent with a highly automated Ocado CFC).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Doors split across two faces: inbound semi-trailer docks on the NE face (by the retention pond) and an extensive last-mile delivery-van loading bank on the SW face. Combined door count estimated ~60; flagged uncertain because van-bay doors are smaller and partly occluded by parked vans.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound grocery semis dock on the NE building face; outbound last-mile delivery vans load from the SW face and stage in the NW van lot - physically separate clusters on different faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large fleet of Kroger Delivery vans (not standard trailers) parked in herringbone rows in the NW lot, plus a band of parked semi-trailers north of the building and along the NE dock apron. Counting both, 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/van storage: NW van-fleet lot (dozens of branded delivery vans) and a trailer drop band north of the building, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and deep internal drives with ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / agricultural setting on the Pleasant Prairie outskirts - farmland immediately west and south, scattered industrial buildings. Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail/utility corridor runs diagonally NE of the property but no spur enters the CFC site.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: 2023-08 Street View coverage exists along the 88th Ave frontage (pano at ~42.54294,-87.91334) showing the fenced perimeter and building front; exact pano_id not captured via probe, hasCoverage true with headings pointing from the road toward the gate/perimeter.

citations.claim: Kroger is closing its Wisconsin CFC in January 2026; not meeting financial expectations.
WARN notice for Pleasant Prairie facility at 9091 88th Ave: 211 employees laid off, permanently closes Feb 1 2026.

verification.rationale: REJECTED: Pleasant Prairie WI CFC is one of three Kroger is shutting down; WARN filed, closes Feb 1 2026.
